title: Silver plan: sum insured
text: The Silver plan covers hospitalisation up to a sum insured of INR 5,00,000 per policy year, including room, nursing and doctor fees.

title: Silver plan: room rent limit
text: Room rent under the Silver plan is limited to 1 percent of the sum insured per day. Higher room rent reduces the claim proportionately.

title: Gold plan: sum insured
text: The Gold plan covers hospitalisation up to a sum insured of INR 10,00,000 per policy year, with no proportionate deduction on room rent.

title: Gold plan: exclusion for cosmetic treatment
text: The Gold plan does not cover cosmetic or aesthetic procedures unless they follow an accident covered under the policy.

title: Platinum plan: sum insured
text: The Platinum plan covers hospitalisation up to INR 25,00,000 per policy year and adds international emergency cover.

title: Waiting period for pre-existing conditions
text: Pre-existing conditions are covered only after 36 continuous months of renewals. Specific listed illnesses have a 24 month waiting period.

title: Insured declared value
text: The insured declared value is the market value of the vehicle at policy start, reduced each year by the standard depreciation schedule.

title: No-claim bonus
text: A no-claim bonus of 20 percent on the own-damage premium applies after one claim-free year and grows to 50 percent after five. A claim resets it.

title: Zero depreciation add-on
text: The zero depreciation add-on pays the full cost of replaced parts without deducting depreciation, for up to two claims per policy year.

title: Grace period for premium payment
text: A grace period of 30 days applies for annual premiums. Cover continues during the grace period and lapses if the premium is unpaid after it.

title: Free-look period
text: A new term policy can be cancelled within 30 days of receipt for a refund of the premium, less stamp duty and medical costs.

title: Revival of a lapsed policy
text: A lapsed term policy can be revived within 24 months of the first unpaid premium by paying all dues with interest and submitting health proof.

title: Renewal and grace rules
text: A policy renews on its renewal date. Within 30 days after the date it is in grace and can still be renewed. After 30 days it is lapsed and needs a new proposal.
